text:
A galaxy is at a distance of 60 million light-years from the Earth. The galaxy is moving away at a
speed of 1300km/s.
One light-year is about 9.5 × 1012
km.
There are about 3.2 × 107 seconds in one year.
Which expression can be used to estimate the age of the Universe in years?
60  106 3.2  107
A
1300  9.5  1012
60  106 9.5  1012
B
1300  3.2  107
1300  9.5  1012
C
60  106 3.2  107
1300  3.2  107
D
60  106 9.5  1012
